name: A Chance Encounter
source:
This is a parody dating simulator visual novel about getting isekai’d into a fantasy world to date monsters and a wizard. This might sound great on paper, but some guy has cursed you, and the dialogue choices are random… Pick from a variety of thoughts, both negative and positive, to weigh the odds in your favor! Try to think about their personality, as well as potentially ‘genre tropes’, when deciding what options to pick, sometimes it might be surprising.

[From [url=https://jacob2312.itch.io/a-chance-encounter]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款恋爱模拟视觉小说恶搞作，讲述你转生到异世界，与怪物和巫师约会的故事。听起来很美好，对吧？可你被某个男人诅咒了，对话选项还会随机变化……从各种正面或负面的想法中作出选择，设法让胜算偏向自己！选择时要考虑对方的性格，以及可能出现的“类型套路”；有时结果会让你大吃一惊。

[来源：[url=https://jacob2312.itch.io/a-chance-encounter]Itch.io[/url]]
